original_text: This authored demonstration contains 200 synthetic reports. It illustrates why higher error detection does not necessarily mean better overall review. No patients, readers, or trained models were studied.
translation_zh: 本自编演示包含 200 份合成报告，用来说明更高的错误检出率不一定意味着更好的总体审阅效果。本演示未研究患者、阅片者或受训模型。
logical_role: 界定这是教学构造，结论只涉及给定算术例子。
critical_commentary: 不能将这些数字当作真实模型的临床证据。

original_text: The synthetic dataset has 40 reports with errors and 160 reports without errors. The two conditions are constructed rules applied to the same reports, rather than independent human reading experiments.
translation_zh: 合成数据集包含 40 份有错误报告和 160 份无错误报告。两个条件是在同一批报告上应用的构造规则，而不是独立的人工阅片实验。
logical_role: 明确两组结果共享同一数据及已知标签。
critical_commentary: 同一病例构造比较不证明规则在新材料上的泛化能力。

original_text: Rule A flags 26 of the 40 error reports and 8 of the 160 correct reports. Rule B flags 35 of the 40 error reports and 15 of the 160 correct reports.
translation_zh: 规则 A 标记 40 份错误报告中的 26 份，以及 160 份正确报告中的 8 份。规则 B 标记 40 份错误报告中的 35 份，以及 160 份正确报告中的 15 份。
logical_role: 提供表格和图形的原始计数，区分真正例和假警报。
critical_commentary: 规则 B 提高检出数量，也增加对正确报告的误报。

original_text: Recall rises from 0.65 to 0.875, but the false-alert proportion also rises from 0.05 to 0.09375. The denominator for recall is 40, whereas the denominator for false alerts is 160.
translation_zh: 召回率从 0.65 升至 0.875，但假警报比例也从 0.05 升至 0.09375。召回率的分母是 40，而假警报比例的分母是 160。
logical_role: 用两个不同分母解释同一规则改变的收益与代价。
critical_commentary: 不要把假警报比例的分母换成全部 200 份报告，或把召回率升高概括为所有指标均改善。

original_text: A reviewer who only sees recall may prefer Rule B. That preference depends on the costs of missed errors and unnecessary alerts. These costs were not measured, so the demonstration does not establish which rule is more useful.
translation_zh: 只看到召回率的审阅者可能更偏好规则 B。该偏好取决于漏检错误和不必要警报的代价。本演示没有测量这些代价，因此不能确定哪条规则更有用。
logical_role: 将指标变化与实际效用分开，避免把算术例子提升为部署结论。
critical_commentary: 真实应用需要额外的效用和工作流程研究。

original_text: The transferable lesson is to report both benefits and errors with their denominators. All counts can be regenerated from the accompanying CSV. The example is complete as an authored teaching fixture, not as evidence about a medical system.
translation_zh: 可迁移的做法是同时报告收益、错误及各自分母。所有计数均可由随附 CSV 重建。该示例是完整的自编教学样例，不是医疗系统的实证证据。
logical_role: 总结本例能支持的阅读方法，并提供可复算数据。
critical_commentary: 不对真实论文的模型效果作出推断。

highlights.quote: report both benefits and errors with their denominators
